name: 04351 · Manchester, ME
findings: ZIP 04351 (Manchester) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04351 (Manchester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 04351 (Manchester) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
